user.title: Energy Flow Mapper
user.description: Adds an admin panel to view and edit the energy dashboard configuration as a diagram. Your energy settings are not changed by the setup.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Energy Flow Mapper is already set up.

init.title: Backups
init.description: Before every save, Energy Flow Mapper backs up your previous energy settings in the Home Assistant configuration folder, so they are part of every Home Assistant backup.

data_description.max_backups: Between 5 and 100. If you lower the number, the oldest backups beyond it are deleted.

not_loaded.message: Energy Flow Mapper is not loaded.

unsupported_energy_api.message: The energy settings of this Home Assistant release are not supported by Energy Flow Mapper.

conflict.message: The energy settings or groups were changed elsewhere in the meantime. Reload and try again.

restore_invalid.message: This backup cannot be restored: together with the current energy settings it would cause errors ({issues}).

device_exists.message: {stat} is already in the energy dashboard.

unknown_device.message: {stat} is not a device in the energy dashboard.

invalid_import.message: The file is not an Energy Flow Mapper export: {error}

rejected_by_home_assistant.message: Home Assistant rejected the energy settings: {error}

unknown_source.message: {stat} is not a source in the energy dashboard.

not_a_power_candidate.message: {entity_id} is not a power or flow sensor without a meter.

not_a_solar_power.message: {entity_id} is not the power sensor of a saved solar source.

integral_failed.message: The helper for the meter could not be created.

sum_not_possible.message: {entity} cannot be summed: it needs to be a sensor with the right device class and a total or total-increasing state class.

sum_state_classes_differ.message: The sensors do not all have the same state class (total or total increasing), so their sum would not be accepted as a meter.

sum_failed.message: The sum meter could not be created.

template_failed.message: The template helper for the meter could not be created.

no_returned_sensor.message: {entity_id} has no returned energy sensor on its device, so it cannot be set up as a meter that only counts what it draws.

returned_disabled.message: The returned energy sensor {entity_id} is disabled. Enable it in its entity settings in Home Assistant first.

daily_without_power.message: {entity_id} starts again at 0 every day and has no power sensor to build a meter from, so the gross meter cannot be created.

unsupported_input.message: {entity_id} cannot be used in the gross meter: it needs to be a sensor with an energy or power unit.

solar_already_in_meter.message: {entity_id} already adds up the solar, so a gross meter would count the solar twice. Use it as it is, or remove the solar from the sum first.

daily_check_failed.message: The check whether the meters of {entity_id} start again at 0 every day could not run: the recorder did not answer in time. Try again in a moment.

input_not_ready.message: {entity_id} has no value right now, so the starting value of the gross meter cannot be set. Try again when it reports one.

home_not_supported.message: This Home Assistant release has no home meter; it needs 2026.11 or newer.

invalid_power_config.message: The power sensor does not fit this source: grid and battery need one sensor, an inverted one, or two for each direction; other sources one sensor.

home_exists.message: There is already a home meter.

group_parents_differ.message: {stat} does not belong below the same device as this group.

group_loop.message: A group cannot be moved into itself or below one of its own devices ({stat}).

group_name_taken.message: There is already a group called {stat} here.

unsupported_energy_api.title: Energy Flow Mapper does not support this Home Assistant release
unsupported_energy_api.description: The energy settings of this Home Assistant release do not match what Energy Flow Mapper expects. To protect your settings, the editor is disabled. Update Energy Flow Mapper, or report the problem if no update is available.
